name: LEGO-Prover
org: Tsinghua University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
one_liner: Grows a persistent library of verified Isabelle/HOL helper lemmas while proving theorems block-by-block.

loop.proposes: A prover LLM decomposes a theorem into candidate helper lemmas and formal Isabelle proof sketches, while an evolvar LLM mutates verified lemmas in the skill library.
loop.judged_by: The Isabelle/HOL kernel and Sledgehammer verify every proposed lemma and proof sketch.
loop.steers: Verified lemmas are indexed into a growing modular skill library and retrieved via semantic search to simplify subsequent theorems.

headline_result: Raised miniF2F-valid pass@100 to 57.0% and miniF2F-test to 50.0% in Isabelle/HOL, accumulating thousands of reusable verified lemmas.
caveat: Library quality depends on pruning redundant or overly specialized lemmas so retrieval stays sharp.
beyond_harness_note: The Isabelle/HOL kernel gates admission into a persistent, evolving library of formally verified mathematical lemmas.
generative_model: GPT-3.5 / LLaMA-2 prover and lemma-evolver agents
algorithmic_authority: Isabelle/HOL proof kernel and Sledgehammer ATP

sources.title: LEGO-Prover: Neural Theorem Proving with Growing Libraries (ICLR 2024 / arXiv:2310.00656)

verification.notes: Checked against Wang et al., ICLR 2024.
